title: GPU Demand Boarding Log — triage & approvals
content:
Purpose: running log for incoming GPU capacity requests (boarding-style). Use this sheet for triage, quick allocation proposals, approver assignment, and notes about blockers (network, VPC, KMS, model compatibility). This is a working doc: keep rows compact and add Slack thread link for follow-up.

Columns: Request ID | Team | Requester (email) | Project / feature | Primary use case | GPUs requested (count + type) | Preferred region(s) | Start window | Hard deadline | Priority (P0/P1/P2) | Triage owner | Approval status | Approver | Quick allocation proposal | Notes / blockers / follow-ups | Slack thread | Next action (owner)

Rows:
1. RQ-2026-074 | Search Re-ranker | priya@redwood.ai | rank-v2 | A/B rerank for web-search (latency sensitive) | 8 x A100-80GB | us-west1 | 2026-06-01 to 2026-09-01 | 2026-06-15 | P0 | Ethan Cole | approved (partial) | Lina Zhou | Reserve 6 A100 + 2 burst H100 for load spikes; colocate with cache pods | Need KV cache prefixing enabled; perf eval on 2048 tokens in staging | slack:#search-rerank-reqs | infra will tag reservation (Marcus)
2. RQ-2026-081 | Personalization | sofia@redwood.ai | user-embeddings-v3 | daily offline embeddings + live low-latency lookup | 4 x L4 | us-central1, europe-west1 | flexible start 2026-06 | 2026-08-01 | P1 | Marcus Lee | pending | — | Suggest reserved 4 L4 in us-central, mirror 2 L4 in europe for fallback | Data residency question for EU customers — contact privacy | slack:#personalization | Follow-up with privacy (Sofia)
3. RQ-2026-089 | Research / Applied ML | lina@redwood.ai | quantization-experiments | long-running hyperparam sweep | 16 x H100 | us-west2 | start 2026-05-25 | no hard deadline | P2 | Priya Raman | blocked - quota | Marcus Lee | Propose preemptible H100 nodes / short burst windows (overnight) | Needs kernel build for 8-bit custom op; PR #412 referenced | slack:#applied-ml | Submit infra-build ticket (Ethan)
4. RQ-2026-095 | Customer P0 (ACME Corp) | evan@solutions | private-deploy | dedicated private deployment proof-of-concept | 12 x A100 + 4 x H100 | europe-west1 | 2026-07-01 | 2026-07-15 | P0 | Marcus Lee | needs legal sign-off | Priya Raman | Reserve capacity candidate pool in Dedicated; flag private deploy checklist | Compliance docs pending (DPA, SOC2 appendix) | slack:#enterprise-onboarding | Solutions to pull legal docs (Evan)
5. RQ-2026-101 | Console feature | jamal@product | rollout-telemetry | telemetry aggregation + evals (short burst) | 2 x T4 or L4 | us-east1 | 2026-05-20 | 2026-06-05 | P2 | Priya Raman | approved | Ethan Cole | Use shared low-cost pool (burst); recommend L4 if latency matters | Could reuse existing telemetry GPU pool — check quotas | slack:#console-telemetry | Assign to infra-ops for scheduling
6. RQ-2026-112 | Model Onboarding | rachel@modelops | bloomfilt-7b | 1-shot model validation + perf baseline | 1 x A100-40GB | us-west1 | 2026-05-22 | 2026-05-30 | P1 | Ethan Cole | approved | Marcus Lee | Single A100 reserved for 10 days; add eval job to perf-queue | Need to check quantization path (8-bit vs 4-bit) | slack:#model-onboarding | Modelops to push artifacts to staging
7. RQ-2026-118 | Benchmarks | infra-eng | stressbench | fleet utilization stress test (monthly) | variable: 40 GPU-hours total (prefer H100) | us-west1 | 2026-05-28 | none | P2 | Marcus Lee | scheduled | SRE Lead | Use rotating windows, night-only to avoid customer impact | Coordinate with routing team to route low-priority to burst pool | slack:#sre-bench | SRE to publish schedule

Triage notes (short):
- Pool design: we have 3 pools available for short-term planning: reserved-monthly, burst-preemptible, and shared-low-cost. Try to fit P0 into reserved or dedicated; P1 into burst-durable; P2 into shared.
- Region constraints: europe-west1 currently has limited H100 availability; recommend early booking for any H100-heavy requests.
- Quota workflow: blocked requests usually need quota increase (GH:repo/infra/quota-requests) and sometimes billing approval for Dedicated pools.
- Approver matrix: Marcus (infra lead) approves standard infra reservations; Priya approves research allocations; Lina approves Dedicated/private deployments (legal checks).

Action items (short):
- Ethan: create quota ticket for RQ-2026-089 and attach kernel build notes (due 2026-05-21).
- Solutions: gather legal templates for ACME (due 2026-05-25).
- Marcus: tag and create a short-term reservation for RQ-2026-074 (6 A100) and notify search team.

Versioning: this is a living intake log. For bigger requests, create a linked intake doc (use Confluence template) and add the Confluence link in linked_artifacts. Keep note field updated with Slack thread and PR links.

End of sheet (last updated 2026-05-20 by Marcus Lee).
